subject: Re: Spike in latency + 5xxs – reserved capacity impacted

From: Alex Jenkins <alex.jenkins@northbridgebank.com>

Cc: accounts@northbridgebank.com, Laura SRE <laura.sre@northbridgebank.com>
Date: Thu, 4 Feb 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Spike in latency + 5xxs – reserved capacity impacted

Mina,

We're seeing a sharp degradation in our production flows starting ~08:45 PST. 95th latency for our main completion endpoint jumped from ~210ms to ~2.1s and the 5xx rate climbed to ~5.8% across the last 20 minutes. Throughput from our side is well below our reserved commit (we're only getting ~60% of the expected QPS), which is causing downstream retries and queueing on our end.

This is customer-impacting — payments are being delayed and our downstream backoffs are compounding. We've attached a short logs slice and a telemetry screenshot. Please treat this as urgent: we need an explanation (root cause) and an ETA to return to normal.

Per our SLA, this is a priority. If you can assemble an incident bridge and give us an interim mitigation, that would be appreciated.

Alex
Alex Jenkins
Director, Platform Engineering
Northbridge Bank

Attachments: northbridge_service_logs_20270204.zip (log archive), initial-telemetry-slice.png (PNG screenshot)
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.inference.com>

Subject: Re: Spike in latency + 5xxs – reserved capacity impacted

Alex — thanks for the quick note and the logs. I'm on it and have flagged the issue with our on-call infra and prod teams.

Immediate plan (first 120 minutes):
- Stand up an incident bridge now (joining details below).
- Engineering (David) to confirm whether customer's dedicated GPU pool is saturated and whether autoscale/burst is blocked.
- Ops (Karthik) to enable emergency burst routing & consider routing a portion of traffic to the fallback model variant to relieve headroom.
- Sales/AM (Marissa/Monica) to coordinate customer comms and contract/SLA implications.

I'll escalate to the CTO if we don't have stable service within 2 hours.

Bridge: https://meet.redwood.internal/bridge/nb-urgent-20270204 (pw: redwoodNB)
Incident ticket: SUP-9876 (https://jira.redwood.internal/browse/SUP-9876)

Subject: Re: Spike in latency + 5xxs – reserved capacity impacted

On it — I pulled the first telemetry slice. Quick findings:
- Customer's dedicated GPU pool for northbridge-prod is at 98–100% GPU utilization across 4 nodes. Queue depth for fast-path tokenization is spiking, and we've got sustained KV cache misses on the model variant they're pinned to.
- Autoscale signals are present but the pool's burst flag was accidentally disabled in the policy last night during a config rollout (config-change SUP-9789). Because burst was disabled, requests are queuing rather than allowing transient headroom.
- We're also seeing higher-than-normal tokenization cost for a subset of the customer prompts (longer context windows).

Mitigation I can apply immediately (requesting approval to proceed):
1) Re-enable burst on the customer's pool (will allow temporary headroom across the fleet).
2) Shift 25% of incoming traffic to the lighter-weight fallback model variant (same API surface, lower per-token compute).
3) Increase per-pool concurrency limit for northbridge-prod by +20% for the next 2 hours while we monitor.

Expected outcome: latency should fall back to <400ms p95 within 5–10 minutes of applying 1+2, and 5xxs should drop significantly. Risk: small incremental cost and potential transient cold starts on fallback variant.

If I don't get a thumbs up here in 5 mins, I'll proceed with 1 (burst) and 2 (traffic split) under emergency change authority for critical customers.

- David

--
David Kim
Senior SRE, Serving Runtime
Redwood Inference
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.inference.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.inference.com>, david_kim@redwood.inference.com
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.inference.com
Date: Thu, 4 Feb 2027 09:55:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Spike in latency + 5xxs – reserved capacity impacted

I approve David's plan and am executing now:
- Re-enabled burst for northbridge-prod pool (change applied).
- Started traffic split to fallback-variant (25% routed away from heavy model).
- Bumped pool concurrency by 20%.
- Opening a rapid change ticket: SUP-9876 -> SUP-9876-CHG1 (https://jira.redwood.internal/browse/SUP-9876).

Monitoring: Grafana link (live): https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/throughput/northbridge-overview?orgId=1. I'm watching queue depth, token latency, and 5xx rate.

Note on cost: these changes will increase short-term unit consumption on the customer's reserved pool; we should make finance aware if this becomes a multi-hour remediation.

Karthik

Can you validate on your side whether retries/queueing have cleared? We're standing up a 10:30 bridge to confirm full recovery and to walk through short-term actions we're taking and a longer-term remediation (policy fix and retro).

Subject: Post-incident: Northbridge reserve bleed — summary and credit ask

Team — final write-up for leadership and finance: the Northbridge incident on 2027-02-04 resulted from an operational config rollout that inadvertently disabled burst for their dedicated pool (SUP-9789). The sequence of events:
- 08:45: Headroom began to deplete under a sudden workload pattern (longer contexts).
- 08:50–09:10: 5xxs and p95 latency increased; customer notified.
- 09:30: Incident bridge stood up; mitigation executed (burst re-enable, fallback model traffic split, concurrency bump).
- 09:40: Telemetry returned to acceptable thresholds; by 10:00 p95 had returned to <400ms and 5xxs near baseline.

Impact: short window (~25–35 minutes) of degraded service for Northbridge. Customer experienced payment delays and increased retries. Contract: reserved capacity with priority SLAs — the customer has requested an SLA credit as part of the incident.

Requesting approval from finance for a goodwill credit (recommended: 1 month of token credit at our hosted rate for the impacted endpoints) and approval to bill the short-term extra consumption to support costs if finance/leadership prefer not to absorb.

Related items:
- RCA doc (draft) will be delivered EOD Monday: https://docs.redwood.internal/rca/northbridge-20270204-draft
- Jira incident/change: SUP-9876 / SUP-9876-CHG1
